details.description: The outer plan uses four broad quarter-circle corners rather than a radius clamped by the mat's thin vertical dimension.
details.scale: macro; radius approximately 0.55 world units for the preserved 6.25-unit depth

details.description: The central field is low and padded with a restrained convex crown while remaining nearly planar.
details.scale: meso; crown under 0.015 mat units above the edge datum

details.description: A darker continuous wrapped binding creates a rounded raised perimeter with a softly bulged cross-section.
details.scale: meso; approximately 0.055 mat units wide and 0.025 high
details.affects: perimeter profile, silhouette thickness, and edge highlight

details.description: A narrow recessed line separates the woven field from the binding around the complete inset perimeter.
details.scale: micro; groove width approximately 0.008 mat units
details.affects: edge construction line and cavity occlusion

details.description: Short moss thread dashes repeat at even spacing along all four sides and turn continuously through each corner.
details.scale: micro; dash length approximately 0.018 mat units with 0.028 spacing
details.affects: curve-following repeated geometry and thread-color contrast

details.description: Fine interlaced fibers form a dense directional crosshatch across the central field.
details.scale: micro; high-frequency weave repeated about 80 times per mat unit
details.affects: independent normal, roughness, and albedo channels

details.description: Broad low-contrast olive tonal variation prevents the field from reading as a uniform flat color without suggesting dirt.
details.scale: macro and meso; irregular variation over 0.12 to 0.45 mat units

details.description: The wrapped edge shows fine curved and longitudinal fiber marks following the perimeter instead of planar UV stretching.
details.scale: micro; fiber width below 0.003 mat units
details.affects: binding tangent-space normal and roughness direction

details.description: The outer crest of the rounded binding carries a restrained smoother highlight, strongest in the low grazing close-up.
details.scale: micro local mask over the outer 20 percent of binding width
